description: DVF lists the property sales recorded in France's land publication services, published as open data by the tax administration (DGFiP) under a 2018 decree to make land and housing markets transparent. The data come from notarial deeds and cadastral information and cover the last five years; each line is a disposition within a sale with date, nature, price, address, cadastral parcel, type of premises, built floor area, number of main rooms and land area and use. Coverage: metropolitan France and overseas departments except Alsace, Moselle and Mayotte. Access: yearly pipe-separated files updated twice a year, with a notice and conditions of use; data.gouv.fr also publishes a normalised geolocated version (UTF-8 CSV, parcel identifiers, WGS84 coordinates, files per department or commune) and a map application. Cerema's DV3F, which enriches DVF with the land files from 2010, is available to public bodies on request. Licence: Licence Ouverte v2.0 with DGFiP conditions; free. Caveats: reuse must not allow re-identification of persons or indexing by search engines, and one sale spans several lines grouped by a mutation identifier that is not stable between releases. Simulation uses are market value inputs for loss, relocation and investment appraisal models. Related records: the Cerema Fichiers fonciers and Cartofriches.
